package codex // import "github.com/godeps/codex-sdk-go"


VARIABLES

var (
	ErrTransportClosed = errors.New("codex: transport closed")
	ErrLimitExceeded   = errors.New("codex: limit exceeded")
	ErrStreamClosed    = errors.New("codex: stream closed")
)

FUNCTIONS

func IsRetryable(err error) bool
    IsRetryable reports whether err represents a transient server-overload
    failure.

func MapRPCError(code int, message string, data json.RawMessage) error
    MapRPCError maps a JSON-RPC error to the most specific public error type.

func RetryOnOverload[T any](ctx context.Context, options RetryOptions, op func(context.Context) (T, error)) (T, error)
    RetryOnOverload retries op only for transient overload errors.


TYPES

type AgentMessageItem struct {
	ID   string `json:"id"`
	Type string `json:"type"`
	Text string `json:"text"`
}
    AgentMessageItem is a response from the agent.

func (i *AgentMessageItem) ItemType() string

type ApprovalMode string
    ApprovalMode controls the approval policy for tool executions.

const (
	ApprovalNever     ApprovalMode = "never"
	ApprovalOnRequest ApprovalMode = "on-request"
	ApprovalOnFailure ApprovalMode = "on-failure"
	ApprovalUntrusted ApprovalMode = "untrusted"
)
type Codex struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Codex is the main client for interacting with the Codex CLI. Use StartThread
    to begin a new thread or ResumeThread to continue an existing one.

func NewCodex(options CodexOptions) *Codex
    NewCodex constructs a Codex client with optional settings.

func (c *Codex) ResumeThread(id string, options ThreadOptions) *Thread
    ResumeThread continues a conversation using an existing thread ID.

func (c *Codex) StartThread(options ThreadOptions) *Thread
    StartThread begins a new conversation with the agent.

type CodexExec struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    CodexExec launches the Codex CLI.

func NewCodexExec(executablePath string, env map[string]string) *CodexExec
    NewCodexExec creates a new exec wrapper.

func (c *CodexExec) Run(args CodexExecArgs) (*ExecStream, error)
    Run launches the Codex CLI and streams JSONL lines.

type CodexExecArgs struct {
	Input string

	BaseURL  string
	APIKey   string
	Config   map[string]any
	ThreadID string
	Images   []string

	Model                 string
	SandboxMode           SandboxMode
	WorkingDirectory      string
	AdditionalDirectories []string
	SkipGitRepoCheck      bool
	OutputSchemaFile      string
	ModelReasoningEffort  ModelReasoningEffort
	NetworkAccessEnabled  *bool
	WebSearchMode         WebSearchMode
	WebSearchEnabled      *bool
	ApprovalPolicy        ApprovalMode

	Context context.Context
}
    CodexExecArgs describes CLI arguments for codex exec.

type CodexOptions struct {
	CodexPathOverride string
	BaseURL           string
	APIKey            string
	// Config provides additional Codex CLI configuration overrides.
	// The SDK flattens nested objects into repeated --config dotted.path=TOML-value flags.
	Config map[string]any
	// Env overrides the environment passed to the Codex CLI process.
	// When provided, the SDK will not inherit variables from the parent process.
	Env map[string]string
}
    CodexOptions configures the Codex client.

type CommandExecutionItem struct {
	ID               string                 `json:"id"`
	Type             string                 `json:"type"`
	Command          string                 `json:"command"`
	AggregatedOutput string                 `json:"aggregated_output"`
	ExitCode         *int                   `json:"exit_code,omitempty"`
	Status           CommandExecutionStatus `json:"status"`
}
    CommandExecutionItem is a command executed by the agent.

func (i *CommandExecutionItem) ItemType() string

type CommandExecutionStatus string
    CommandExecutionStatus is the status of a command execution.

const (
	CommandExecutionInProgress CommandExecutionStatus = "in_progress"
	CommandExecutionCompleted  CommandExecutionStatus = "completed"
	CommandExecutionFailed     CommandExecutionStatus = "failed"
)
type ErrorItem struct {
	ID      string `json:"id"`
	Type    string `json:"type"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
}
    ErrorItem is a non-fatal error surfaced as an item.

func (i *ErrorItem) ItemType() string

type ExecStream struct {
	Lines <-chan string
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    ExecStream streams lines from the Codex CLI.

func (s *ExecStream) Wait() error
    Wait blocks until the process exits and returns any error.

type FileChangeItem struct {
	ID      string             `json:"id"`
	Type    string             `json:"type"`
	Changes []FileUpdateChange `json:"changes"`
	Status  PatchApplyStatus   `json:"status"`
}
    FileChangeItem describes a set of file changes.

func (i *FileChangeItem) ItemType() string

type FileUpdateChange struct {
	Path string          `json:"path"`
	Kind PatchChangeKind `json:"kind"`
}
    FileUpdateChange describes a file change.

type Input struct {
	Text  string
	Items []UserInput
}
    Input describes a turn input. Provide Text or Items.

func ItemsInput(items ...UserInput) Input
    ItemsInput creates an Input with structured entries.

func TextInput(text string) Input
    TextInput creates an Input with a text prompt.

type InternalRPCError struct{ *RPCError }

func (e *InternalRPCError) Unwrap() error

type InvalidParamsError struct{ *RPCError }

func (e *InvalidParamsError) Unwrap() error

type InvalidRequestError struct{ *RPCError }

func (e *InvalidRequestError) Unwrap() error

type McpToolCallError struct {
	Message string `json:"message"`
}
    McpToolCallError is an MCP tool error payload.

type McpToolCallItem struct {
	ID        string             `json:"id"`
	Type      string             `json:"type"`
	Server    string             `json:"server"`
	Tool      string             `json:"tool"`
	Arguments any                `json:"arguments"`
	Result    *McpToolCallResult `json:"result,omitempty"`
	Error     *McpToolCallError  `json:"error,omitempty"`
	Status    McpToolCallStatus  `json:"status"`
}
    McpToolCallItem represents a call to an MCP tool.

func (i *McpToolCallItem) ItemType() string

type McpToolCallResult struct {
	Content           []map[string]any `json:"content,omitempty"`
	StructuredContent any              `json:"structured_content,omitempty"`
}
    McpToolCallResult holds a successful MCP tool response.

type McpToolCallStatus string
    McpToolCallStatus is the status of an MCP tool call.

const (
	McpToolCallInProgress McpToolCallStatus = "in_progress"
	McpToolCallCompleted  McpToolCallStatus = "completed"
	McpToolCallFailed     McpToolCallStatus = "failed"
)
type MethodNotFoundError struct{ *RPCError }

func (e *MethodNotFoundError) Unwrap() error

type ModelReasoningEffort string
    ModelReasoningEffort configures the model reasoning effort.

const (
	ReasoningMinimal ModelReasoningEffort = "minimal"
	ReasoningLow     ModelReasoningEffort = "low"
	ReasoningMedium  ModelReasoningEffort = "medium"
	ReasoningHigh    ModelReasoningEffort = "high"
	ReasoningXHigh   ModelReasoningEffort = "xhigh"
)
type ParseError struct{ *RPCError }

func (e *ParseError) Unwrap() error

type PatchApplyStatus string
    PatchApplyStatus is the status of a file change patch.

const (
	PatchApplyCompleted PatchApplyStatus = "completed"
	PatchApplyFailed    PatchApplyStatus = "failed"
)
type PatchChangeKind string
    PatchChangeKind indicates a file change type.

const (
	PatchChangeAdd    PatchChangeKind = "add"
	PatchChangeDelete PatchChangeKind = "delete"
	PatchChangeUpdate PatchChangeKind = "update"
)
type RPCError struct {
	Code    int
	Message string
	Data    json.RawMessage
}
    RPCError is an error returned by the app-server JSON-RPC endpoint.

func (e *RPCError) Error() string

type ReasoningItem struct {
	ID   string `json:"id"`
	Type string `json:"type"`
	Text string `json:"text"`
}
    ReasoningItem captures the agent's reasoning summary.

func (i *ReasoningItem) ItemType() string

type RetryLimitExceededError struct{ *RPCError }

func (e *RetryLimitExceededError) Unwrap() error

type RetryOptions struct {
	MaxAttempts  int
	InitialDelay time.Duration
	MaxDelay     time.Duration
	JitterRatio  float64
}
    RetryOptions configures RetryOnOverload.

func DefaultRetryOptions() RetryOptions
    DefaultRetryOptions matches the reference SDK retry behavior.

type SandboxMode string
    SandboxMode controls filesystem access for the Codex CLI.

const (
	SandboxReadOnly         SandboxMode = "read-only"
	SandboxWorkspaceWrite   SandboxMode = "workspace-write"
	SandboxDangerFullAccess SandboxMode = "danger-full-access"
)
type ServerBusyError struct{ *RPCError }

func (e *ServerBusyError) Unwrap() error

type StreamedTurn struct {
	Events <-chan ThreadEvent
	Done   <-chan error
}
    StreamedTurn is the result of RunStreamed.

type Thread struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Thread represents a conversation with the agent.

func NewThread(exec *CodexExec, options CodexOptions, threadOptions ThreadOptions, id string) *Thread
    NewThread constructs a thread.

func (t *Thread) ID() string
    ID returns the thread identifier. It is populated after the first turn
    starts.

func (t *Thread) Run(input Input, turnOptions TurnOptions) (*Turn, error)
    Run sends input to the agent and returns the completed turn.

func (t *Thread) RunStreamed(input Input, turnOptions TurnOptions) (*StreamedTurn, error)
    RunStreamed sends input to the agent and streams events.

type ThreadError struct {
	Message string `json:"message"`
}
    ThreadError indicates a failure in the stream.

type ThreadEvent struct {
	Type     string       `json:"type"`
	ThreadID string       `json:"thread_id,omitempty"`
	Usage    *Usage       `json:"usage,omitempty"`
	Error    *ThreadError `json:"error,omitempty"`
	Item     ThreadItem   `json:"item,omitempty"`
	Message  string       `json:"message,omitempty"`
}
    ThreadEvent represents a top-level JSONL event.

func (e *ThreadEvent) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error

type ThreadItem interface {
	ItemType() string
}
    ThreadItem is a union of item payloads emitted by Codex.

type ThreadOptions struct {
	Model                 string
	SandboxMode           SandboxMode
	WorkingDirectory      string
	SkipGitRepoCheck      bool
	ModelReasoningEffort  ModelReasoningEffort
	NetworkAccessEnabled  *bool
	WebSearchMode         WebSearchMode
	WebSearchEnabled      *bool
	ApprovalPolicy        ApprovalMode
	AdditionalDirectories []string
}
    ThreadOptions configures a Codex thread.

type TodoItem struct {
	Text      string `json:"text"`
	Completed bool   `json:"completed"`
}
    TodoItem is a single entry in the agent's todo list.

type TodoListItem struct {
	ID    string     `json:"id"`
	Type  string     `json:"type"`
	Items []TodoItem `json:"items"`
}
    TodoListItem tracks the agent's todo list.

func (i *TodoListItem) ItemType() string

type Turn struct {
	Items         []ThreadItem
	FinalResponse string
	Usage         *Usage
}
    Turn represents a completed turn.

type TurnOptions struct {
	// OutputSchema is a JSON schema describing the expected agent output.
	OutputSchema any
	// Context controls cancellation for the turn.
	Context context.Context
}
    TurnOptions configures a single turn.

type UnknownItem struct {
	Type string          `json:"type"`
	Raw  json.RawMessage `json:"raw"`
}
    UnknownItem preserves forward-compatible item payloads emitted by newer
    Codex CLIs.

func (i *UnknownItem) ItemType() string

type Usage struct {
	InputTokens       int `json:"input_tokens"`
	CachedInputTokens int `json:"cached_input_tokens"`
	OutputTokens      int `json:"output_tokens"`
}
    Usage describes token usage for a turn.

type UserInput struct {
	Type UserInputType `json:"type"`
	Text string        `json:"text,omitempty"`
	URL  string        `json:"url,omitempty"`
	Name string        `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Path string        `json:"path,omitempty"`
}
    UserInput represents a structured input entry.

func DataURLImageInput(url string) UserInput
    DataURLImageInput creates a structured image input from a data URL.

func LocalImageInput(path string) UserInput
    LocalImageInput creates a structured local-image input.

func MentionInput(name, path string) UserInput
    MentionInput creates a structured resource mention.

func SkillInput(name, path string) UserInput
    SkillInput creates a structured skill reference.

type UserInputType string
    UserInputType represents the type of an input entry.

const (
	UserInputText       UserInputType = "text"
	UserInputLocalImage UserInputType = "local_image"
	UserInputImage      UserInputType = "image"
	UserInputSkill      UserInputType = "skill"
	UserInputMention    UserInputType = "mention"
)
type WebSearchItem struct {
	ID    string `json:"id"`
	Type  string `json:"type"`
	Query string `json:"query"`
}
    WebSearchItem captures a web search request.

func (i *WebSearchItem) ItemType() string

type WebSearchMode string
    WebSearchMode controls web search behavior.

const (
	WebSearchDisabled WebSearchMode = "disabled"
	WebSearchCached   WebSearchMode = "cached"
	WebSearchLive     WebSearchMode = "live"
)
